CustomField.formula: CASE( MOD( Rep_Ownership_Date__c - DATE( 1900, 1, 7 ), 7 ), 0, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 0 + 3, /* Sun:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+0 wknd day+3 day */ 3, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 2 + 1, /* Wed:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +2 day+2 wknd days+1 days */ 4, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 2 + 2, /* Thr:Rep_Ownership_Date__c +1 day+2 wknd days+2 days */ 5, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 2 + 3, /* Fri:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+2 wknd days+3 days */ 6, Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 1 + 3, /* Sat:Rep_Ownership_Date__c+1 wknd days+3 days */ Rep_Ownership_Date__c + 3 /* Default (Mon/Tue):Rep_Ownership_Date__c+3day */ )
CustomField.label: Business Day (3rd)
